result: limited: DOM loaded and Files/search controls present with no JS/console/HTTP errors, but 0 search hits because the browser restored the duplicate D02 workspace bound to the other v5 binding whose root lacks the fixture.

finding.summary: Two m1-a bindings for the same D02 project share the display name "D02 Remote Project · v5"; the shell restored/selected the binding whose remote root did not contain the T-205 fixture, so the browser search returned zero hits even though server-side search/reference passed on the connected binding.
finding.implication: Browser-level remote sidebar acceptance needs a deterministic workspace/binding selection (distinct display names or removal of the duplicate binding, which would require a delete operation that is outside the standing constraints).
